question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f5f098157c32e144ef1716f08d1cfcc75280332358759e608f014ac1a4a20ed.png] 

The ratio of the actual production of ACs in February and April to that of the target production of ACs in January and April is:
solution:
Calculation:

The actual production of ACs in February and April = (50 + 80) = 130 thousands

The target production of ACs in January and April = (60 + 90) = 150 thousands

Hence, the ratio = 130 : 150 = 13 : 15

**∴ The ratio of the actual production of ACs in February and April to that of the target production of ACs in January and April is 13 : 15.**
